notOptions: Text box for the summary/manual inputs

differences.what: Problem is a repeating section, one entry per diagnosis, up to 10, titled Problem {n}. The status and the interventions are asked for each.
differences.why: inventory A16; forms 2.3; PLAN-OPEN (forms 10.1 #1): the most problems in one note

differences.what: The diagnosis search is a problem field: a code and a label from the problem code list.

Status is choose-one with the four labels of the comma list: New, Chronic, Improving, Worse (added, because a Status: line is not read as words). The problem list maps New to New and the other three to Ongoing.
Choose-many. Other asks for a short text. The options record what was done; orders, referrals and supplies are entered on their own screens.
The Encounter Summary text box is no field of any note: it is the visit's assessment on the summary screen.
